summary.name: Hewbo CHM Reader
summary.one_liner: A web-based or downloadable CHM Reader from Hewbo for opening, viewing, searching and converting Compiled HTML Help (.chm) files.
use_cases: Opening CHM help files without Windows HTML Help
Converting CHM documents to PDF or DOCX
Extracting HTML content from a CHM file for editing
Searching topics inside a software help file
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a CHM Reader tool that lets users open, view and convert Compiled HTML Help (.chm) files. It offers navigation through a file's section structure and a search function for topics and keywords within a CHM file. Conversion options are listed as PDF, DOCX, HTML and others. The page says the tool works with different CHM formats. The page itself is mostly promotional and gives few technical details.
notable: Converts CHM files to PDF, DOCX, HTML and other formats
Built-in search for topics and keywords inside CHM files
Listed as freeware in the awesome-mac list
caveats: Page does not state platform or version details beyond the awesome-mac listing
Page text is mostly marketing; specific format support is not detailed
